hits.title: Consistency-Aware Editing for Entity-level Unlearning in Language Models
hits.note: corpus-seen; TLDR: A novel consistency-aware editing (CAE) framework is introduced that provides insights into how entity-level knowledge is internally represented and deleted in LLMs, significantly improves forgetting accuracy and robustness over traditional unlearning and editing baselines, and enables scalable entity removal using only tens of carefully selected prompts.

hits.title: Towards Reliable, Generalizable, and Specific In-Context Knowledge Editing via Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
hits.note: corpus-seen; TLDR: Multi-Objective In-context Knowledge Editing (MO-IKE), a multi-objective RL algorithm that formulates prompt construction for in-context knowledge editing as a Constrained Markov Decision Process, enabling more balanced and globally coherent prompt construction.

hits.title: QAWiki: A Knowledge Graph Question Answering & SPARQL Query Generation Dataset for Wikidata
hits.note: TLDR: QAWiki is a multilingual, handcrafted, knowledge graph question answering and SPARQL query generation dataset for Wikidata that consists of 526 questions over Wikidata, of which 518 are associated with SPARQL queries, and 8 are disambiguation questions.

hits.title: Towards Profiling Knowledge Graphs
hits.note: TLDR: Methods for Knowledge Graph profiling are discussed, crucial differences of the big, well-known Knowledge Graphs, like DBpedia, YAGO, and Wikidata are depicted, and a glance at current developments of new, complementary Knowledge graphs such as DBkWik and WebIsALOD are thrown at.

hits.title: Introduction: hippocampal function in spatial memory.
hits.note: TLDR: The role of the hippocampus proper and its main direct input and output structures (subiculum, entorhinal cortex and lateral septum) in spatial learning and a rekindle the interest in its role in sleep, a basic process of recovery yet elementary to the development of lasting memories, which are stored in neocortex.

hits.title: GenRecEdit: Adapting Model Editing for Generative Recommendation with Cold-Start Items
hits.note: TLDR: GenRecEdit is proposed, the first model editing framework tailored for generative recommendation, and extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate that øurname substantially improves recommendation performance on cold-start items while preserving the model's original recommendation quality.

hits.title: FlashSAM: Lightweight Vision Model for Multi-UAV Token Communication in Low-Altitude Wireless Networks
hits.note: TLDR: A Lightweight Vision Model-based Multi-Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) Token Communication (LVM-MTC) system, which incorporates a set of lightweight convolutional modules to significantly reduce the number of model parameters, and designs an Efficient Token Codec (ETC) based on the Masked Autoencoder (MAE) architecture.

hits.title: 3D-GOI: 3D GAN Omni-Inversion for Multifaceted and Multi-object Editing
hits.note: TLDR: 3D-GOI is the first framework to enable multifaceted editing of affine information on multiple objects on multiple objects and holds immense potential for flexible, multifaceted editing in complex multi-object scenes.

hits.title: Pioneering Reliable Assessment in Text-to-Image Knowledge Editing: Leveraging a Fine-Grained Dataset and an Innovative Criterion
hits.note: corpus-seen; TLDR: A straightforward implementation of MPE (Based on in-context learning) exhibits better overall performance than previous model editors, and it is hoped these efforts can further promote faithful evaluation of T2I knowledge editing methods.

hits.title: Knowledge Editing for Masked Diffusion Language Models
hits.note: corpus-seen; TLDR: A simple correction is introduced that optimizes the edit including such states in which the target is partially unmasked, substantially restoring multi-token performance in masked diffusion models.

hits.title: Implicit Priors Editing in Stable Diffusion via Targeted Token Adjustment
hits.note: TLDR: Embedding-only Editing (Embedit), a method designed to efficiently adjust implict assumptions and priors in the model without affecting its interpretation of unrelated objects or overall performance, is presented.

hits.title: Ground-A-Score: Scaling Up the Score Distillation for Multi-Attribute Editing
hits.note: TLDR: Ground-A-Score is presented, a simple yet powerful model-agnostic image editing method by incorporating grounding during score distillation that ensures a precise reflection of intricate prompt requirements in the editing outcomes, taking into account the prior knowledge of the object locations within the image.

hits.title: CaseEdit: Enhancing Localized Commonsense Reasoning via Null-Space Constrained Knowledge Editing in Small Parameter Language Models
hits.note: corpus-seen; TLDR: It is demonstrated that AlphaEdit, a technique employing null-space projection to minimize interference with unrelated knowledge, consistently outperforms other methods when applied to an LLaMA 3.2 3B model, even in scalability tests, showing minimal ripple effects.

hits.title: Commonsense Knowledge Editing Based on Free-Text in LLMs
hits.note: TLDR: A Dynamics-aware Editing Method (DEM), which utilizes a Dynamics-aware Module to locate the parameter positions corresponding to commonsense knowledge, and uses Knowledge Editing Module to update knowledge, successfully edits commonsense knowledge based on free-text.

hits.title: EVEDIT: Event-based Knowledge Editing with Deductive Editing Boundaries
hits.note: TLDR: This work introduces a theoretical framework for KE that highlights an overlooked set of knowledge that remains unchanged and aids in knowledge deduction during editing and names as the deduction anchor, and proposes a novel task of event-based knowledge editing that pairs facts with event descriptions.

entries.query: new entity injection language model weights

hits.title: SLiNT: Structure-aware Language Model with Injection and Contrastive Training for Knowledge Graph Completion
hits.note: TLDR: SLiNT (Structure-aware Language model with Injection and coNtrastive Training), a modular framework that injects knowledge-graph-derived structural context into a frozen LLM backbone with lightweight LoRA-based adaptation for robust link prediction, is proposed.

hits.title: BIOptimus: Pre-training an Optimal Biomedical Language Model with Curriculum Learning for Named Entity Recognition
hits.note: TLDR: A new biomedical LM is introduced, which is pre-trained using Curriculum Learning (CL) and contextualized weight distillation method, which sets new states of the art on several biomedical Named Entity Recognition (NER) tasks.

hits.title: CoRA: Collaborative Information Perception by Large Language Model's Weights for Recommendation
hits.note: TLDR: A new paradigm, Collaborative LoRA (CoRA), is proposed with a collaborative filtering model to extract user and item embeddings and inject them into a set number of learnable queries, enabling LLM to perceive the collaborative signals and generate personalized recommendations without fine-tuning or extra collaborative tokens in prompts.

hits.title: TechGPT-2.0: A large language model project to solve the task of knowledge graph construction
hits.note: TLDR: New capabilities to the model are introduced, enabling it to process texts in various domains such as geographical areas, transportation, organizations, literary works, biology, natural sciences, astronomical objects, and architecture, and these enhancements also fortified the model's adeptness in handling hallucinations, unanswerable queries, and lengthy texts.

hits.title: TCM-KLLaMA: Intelligent generation model for Traditional Chinese Medicine Prescriptions based on knowledge graph and large language model
hits.note: TLDR: An effective prescription generation model enriched by a TCM knowledge graph (KG) called the TCM-KLLaMA model is proposed, which outperforms baseline models in both Precision and F1 Score, proving its superior performance in prescription generation tasks.

hits.title: Improving Few-Shot Cross-Domain Named Entity Recognition by Instruction Tuning a Word-Embedding based Retrieval Augmented Large Language Model
hits.note: TLDR: IF-WRANER (Instruction Finetuned Word-embedding based Retrieval Augmented large language model for Named Entity Recognition), a retrieval augmented LLM, finetuned for the NER task is proposed and is able to outperform previous SOTA Few-Shot Cross-Domain NER approaches.

hits.title: Development of a Language Model for Named-Entity-Recognition in Aerospace Requirements
hits.note: TLDR: An open-source annotated aerospace corpus was developed and different versions of the BERT language model on the corpus were fine-tuned to create a new model for identifying named entities (NEs) in the aerospace domain, aeroBERT-NER, demonstrating the superior performance of aeroBERT-NER in identifying NEs within a set of aerospace requirements.

hits.title: SpiRit-LM: Interleaved Spoken and Written Language Model
hits.note: TLDR: SpiRit-LM, a foundation multimodal language model that freely mixes text and speech, is introduced, based on a 7B pretrained text language model that is extended to the speech modality by continuously training it on text and speech units.

hits.title: Enhanced model for abstractive Arabic text summarization using natural language generation and named entity recognition
hits.note: TLDR: This work introduces an innovative framework using Arabic Named Entity Recognition to enhance abstractive summarization, crucial for NLP applications like question answering and knowledge graph construction, and sets a new standard for Arabic text summarization.

hits.title: AdapterEM: Pre-trained Language Model Adaptation for Generalized Entity Matching using Adapter-tuning
hits.note: TLDR: This study proposes a parameter-efficient paradigm for fine-tuning PrLMs based on adapters, small neural networks encapsulated between layers of a PrLM, by optimizing only the adapter and classifier weights while the PrL Ms parameters are frozen.

hits.title: Vocabulary Expansion of Large Language Models via Kullback-Leibler-Based Self-Distillation
hits.note: corpus-seen; TLDR: This work introduces a mathematically grounded method for knowledge distillation via KL divergence, even when the original and extended models use different tokenizations, which allows the student model to inherit distributional knowledge from the teacher despite differing vocabularies.

hits.title: TokAlign: Efficient Vocabulary Adaptation via Token Alignment
hits.note: TLDR: This paper proposes an efficient method named TokAlign to replace the vocabulary of LLM from the token co-occurrences view, and further transfer the token-level knowledge between models, which costs as few as 5k steps to restore the performance of the vanilla model.

hits.title: Graph-Based Lexical Networks for Technical Vocabulary Expansion in IoT-Enabled Education Platforms
hits.note: TLDR: Graph-based Lexical Expansion Network for IoT education (GLEN-IoT), is a system that applies graph mining and natural language processing to generate semantic graphs from technical corpora that improved student recall, semantic coherence, and vocabulary coverage over baseline keyword extraction approaches.

hits.title: Grounded Token Initialization for New Vocabulary in LMs for Generative Recommendation
hits.note: corpus-seen; TLDR: GTI (Grounded Token Initialization), a lightweight grounding stage that, prior to fine-tuning, maps new tokens to distinct, semantically meaningful locations in the pretrained embedding space using only paired linguistic supervision, outperforms both mean initialization and existing auxiliary-task adaptation methods in the majority of evaluation settings.

hits.title: Memory as a Markov Matrix: Sample Efficient Knowledge Expansion via Token-to-Dictionary Mapping
hits.note: TLDR: A principled framework that models autoregressive language generation as a Markov process over tokens, where model memory is represented by a Markov transition matrix, and preserving existing transitions guarantees retention of previously learned knowledge is proposed.

hits.title: Defragmenting Language Models: An Interpretability-based Approach for Vocabulary Expansion
hits.note: TLDR: This work comprehensively study and advances interpretability-based vocabulary expansion, a new research direction, and identifies the phenomenon of "subword detokenization" where models progressively merge fragmented subword tokens into larger subwords across layers.

hits.title: An Empirical Comparison of Vocabulary Expansion and Initialization Approaches For Language Models
hits.note: TLDR: This paper establishes theoretically that initializing within the convex hull of existing embeddings is a good initialization, followed by a novel but simple approach, Constrained Word2Vec (CW2V), which does not require cross-lingual embeddings.

hits.title: TokAlign++: Advancing Vocabulary Adaptation via Better Token Alignment
hits.note: TLDR: This work introduces a method named TokAlign++ to improve vocabulary adaptation performance by learning better token alignment lexicon and shows that this method boosts the multilingual text compression rates and preserves most of the multilingual ability of vanilla models.

hits.title: Efficient and Effective Vocabulary Expansion Towards Multilingual Large Language Models
hits.note: TLDR: It is shown that the EEVE method can significantly boost non-English proficiency within just 2 billion tokens, in contrast to previous efforts that believe new embeddings require trillions of training tokens.

hits.title: Second Language (Arabic) Acquisition of LLMs via Progressive Vocabulary Expansion
hits.note: TLDR: Inspired by the vocabulary learning during Second Language (Arabic) Acquisition for humans, the released AraLLaMA employs progressive vocabulary expansion, which is implemented by a modified BPE algorithm that progressively extends the Arabic subwords in its dynamic vocabulary during training, thereby balancing the OOV ratio at every stage.

hits.title: A Simple Baseline for Unifying Understanding, Generation, and Editing via Vanilla Next-token Prediction
hits.note: TLDR: Wallaroo is introduced, a simple autoregressive baseline that leverages next-token prediction to unify multi-modal understanding, image generation, and editing at the same time and supports multi-resolution image input and output, as well as bilingual support for both Chinese and English.

hits.title: CrisprFusion: A feature fusion model with multi-type input features for sgRNA activity prediction
hits.note: TLDR: CrisprFusion is a deep learning framework that explicitly encodes four biological features through a four-branch input structure that performs fusion at two levels: branch-level gating for adaptive reweighting of different modalities, and token-level alignment for capturing position-specific interactions along the 23-nt sgRNA sequence.

hits.title: Knowledge Editing for Masked Diffusion Language Models
hits.note: corpus-seen; TLDR: A simple correction is introduced that optimizes the edit including such states in which the target is partially unmasked, substantially restoring multi-token performance in masked diffusion models.

hits.title: Edit the Bits, Diff the Codes: Bitwise Residual Editing for Visual Autoregressive Models
hits.note: TLDR: BitResEdit and ResEdit are proposed, a training-free editor for bitwise-residual VAR generators such as Infinity that attains the strongest text alignment among same-backbone VAR editors and plays complementary roles in target alignment and background preservation.

hits.title: Hyper-Bagel: A Unified Acceleration Framework for Multimodal Understanding and Generation
hits.note: TLDR: This work proposes Hyper-Bagel, a unified acceleration framework designed to simultaneously speed up both multimodal understanding and generation tasks, and develops a highly efficient 1-NFE model that enables near real-time interactive editing and generation.

hits.title: Mellum2 Technical Report
hits.note: TLDR: Across code generation, math and reasoning, tool use, knowledge, and safety benchmarks, Mellum 2 is competitive with open-weight baselines in the 4B-14B range while running at the per-token compute of a 2.5B dense model.

hits.title: Better & Faster Large Language Models via Multi-token Prediction
hits.note: TLDR: This work suggests that training language models to predict multiple future tokens at once results in higher sample efficiency, and measures improved downstream capabilities with no overhead in training time for both code and natural language models.

hits.title: VocalNet: Speech LLM with Multi-Token Prediction for Faster and High-Quality Generation
hits.note: TLDR: VocalNet-1B and VocalNet-8B are introduced, a series of high-performance, low-latency speech LLMs enabled by a scalable and model-agnostic training framework designed for real-time voice interaction and the first application of multi-token prediction to speech LLMs.

hits.title: Beyond Multi-Token Prediction: Pretraining LLMs with Future Summaries
hits.note: TLDR: This work proposes future summary prediction (FSP), which trains an auxiliary head to predict a compact representation of the long-term future, preserving information relevant for long-form generations.

hits.title: L-MTP: Leap Multi-Token Prediction Beyond Adjacent Context for Large Language Models
hits.note: TLDR: L-MTP is an innovative token prediction method that extends the capabilities of multi-token prediction by introducing a leap-based mechanism, which enhances the model's ability to capture long-range dependencies but also enables a decoding strategy specially optimized for non-sequential leap token generation, effectively accelerating inference.

hits.title: Knowledge Editing for Masked Diffusion Language Models
hits.note: corpus-seen; TLDR: A simple correction is introduced that optimizes the edit including such states in which the target is partially unmasked, substantially restoring multi-token performance in masked diffusion models.

hits.title: Pioneering Reliable Assessment in Text-to-Image Knowledge Editing: Leveraging a Fine-Grained Dataset and an Innovative Criterion
hits.note: corpus-seen; TLDR: A straightforward implementation of MPE (Based on in-context learning) exhibits better overall performance than previous model editors, and it is hoped these efforts can further promote faithful evaluation of T2I knowledge editing methods.

hits.title: EchoEdit: Consistent Multi-Hop Question Answering via Ripple Control in Knowledge Editing
hits.note: TLDR: EchoEdit introduces the RippleGraph to explicitly model potentially affected knowledge regions and employs a RippleRule generator to dynamically produce diffusion rules, precisely constraining knowledge propagation, effectively enhancing post-edit reasoning consistency and generalization capabilities.

hits.title: Massive Editing for Large Language Models Based on Dynamic Weight Generation
hits.note: TLDR: Experiments show that the proposed MeG can significantly improve the performance of large-scale KE in terms of Reliability, Generality, and Locality metrics compared to existing knowledge editing methods, particularly with a high percentage point increase in the absolute value index for the Locality metric.

hits.title: LLMGA: Multimodal Large Language Model based Generation Assistant
hits.note: TLDR: A Multimodal Large Language Model-based Generation Assistant (LLMGA), leveraging the vast reservoir of knowledge and proficiency in reasoning, comprehension, and response inherent in Large Language Models to assist users in image generation and editing.

hits.title: InstructPix2Pix: Learning to Follow Image Editing Instructions
hits.note: no TLDR shown

hits.title: RAZOR: Ratio-Aware Layer Editing for Targeted Unlearning in Vision Transformers and Diffusion Models
hits.note: TLDR: RAZOR is a lightweight, model-agnostic unlearning framework that generalizes forgetting updates to coordinated multi-layer and multi-head edits within transformer backbones, and achieves highly accurate and stable forgetting, even under quantization.

hits.title: Localizing and Editing Knowledge in Text-to-Image Generative Models
hits.note: TLDR: This paper adapts Causal Mediation Analysis for text-to-image models and trace knowledge about distinct visual attributes to various (causal) components in the (i) UNet and (ii) text-encoder of the diffusion model, and shows that unlike generative large-language models, knowledge about different attributes is not localized in isolated components, but is instead distributed amongst a set of components inThe conditional UNet.

hits.title: SINE: SINgle Image Editing with Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
hits.note: TLDR: A novel model-based guidance built upon the classifier-free guidance is proposed so that the knowledge from the model trained on a single image can be distilled into the pre-trained diffusion model, enabling content creation even with one given image.

hits.title: TimeDiT: General-purpose Diffusion Transformers for Time Series Foundation Model
hits.note: TLDR: TimeDiT is introduced, a diffusion transformer model that synergistically combines transformer-based temporal dependency learning with diffusion-based probabilistic sampling and is established as a proto-foundation model that bridges the gap between general-purpose and domain-specific models.

hits.title: Locating and Editing Factual Associations in Mamba
hits.note: TLDR: The mechanisms of factual recall in the Mamba state space model are investigated, revealing that specific components within middle layers show strong causal effects at the last token of the subject, while the causal effect of intervening on later layers is most pronounced at the last token of the prompt.

hits.title: AI for Sustainable Cultural Industries: A Screenplay-Aware Knowledge-Enhanced State Space Model with LLM-Derived Narrative Features for Forecasting Film Industry Sustainability Across National…
hits.note: TLDR: The results show that knowledge-enhanced sequence models can provide transparent forecasting support for sustainable cultural-industry policy as a test case for artificial intelligence in cultural industries.

hits.title: WikiBigEdit: Understanding the Limits of Lifelong Knowledge Editing in LLMs
hits.note: corpus-seen; TLDR: This work aims to bridge research into lifelong knowledge editing to real-world edits at a practically relevant scale, and introduces WikiBigEdit; a large-scale benchmark of real-world Wikidata edits, built to automatically extend lifelong for future-proof benchmarking.

hits.title: Precise Localization of Memories: A Fine-grained Neuron-level Knowledge Editing Technique for LLMs
hits.note: TLDR: A Fine-grained Neuron-level Knowledge Editing (FiNE) method that enhances editing locality without affecting overall success rates is proposed, providing new insights into the localization and modification of knowledge within LLMs.

hits.title: Editing as Unlearning: Are Knowledge Editing Methods Strong Baselines for Large Language Model Unlearning?
hits.note: TLDR: This paper evaluates state-of-the-art (SOTA) editing methods against existing unlearning approaches on pretrained and finetuned knowledge and shows certain editing methods are effective unlearning baselines, especially for pretrained knowledge, and excel in generating human-aligned refusal answers.

hits.title: AlphaEdit: Null-Space Constrained Knowledge Editing for Language Models
hits.note: TLDR: AlphaEdit, a novel solution that projects perturbation onto the null space of the preserved knowledge before applying it to the parameters, theoretically proves that this projection ensures the output of post-edited LLMs remains unchanged when queried about the preserved knowledge, thereby mitigating the issue of disruption.

hits.title: Decoupling Reasoning and Knowledge Injection for In-Context Knowledge Editing
hits.note: TLDR: DecKER is proposed, a novel ICE framework that decouples reasoning from knowledge editing by generating a masked reasoning path and then resolving knowledge edits via hybrid retrieval and model-based validation.

hits.title: Unlocking Efficient, Scalable, and Continual Knowledge Editing with Basis-Level Representation Fine-Tuning
hits.note: corpus-seen; TLDR: This work explores the feasibility of representation fine-tuning, which applied some linear update to a few representations in a learned subspace, for knowledge editing and theoretically shows that this linear update imposes a tension in editing-locality trade-off, and proposes BaFT, which is proposed to break the linearity.

hits.title: MQuAKE-Remastered: Multi-Hop Knowledge Editing Can Only Be Advanced with Reliable Evaluations
hits.note: no TLDR shown

hits.title: SAKE: Steering Activations for Knowledge Editing
hits.note: corpus-seen; TLDR: SAKE is proposed, a steering activation method that models a fact to be edited as a distribution rather than a single prompt, and is able to perform more robust edits than its existing counterparts.

hits.title: Editing Across Languages: A Survey of Multilingual Knowledge Editing
hits.note: TLDR: A comprehensive taxonomy of MKE methods is presented, covering parameter-based, memory-based, fine-tuning, and hypernetwork approaches, covering parameter-based, memory-based, fine-tuning, and hypernetwork approaches.

hits.title: Latent Knowledge Scalpel: Precise and Massive Knowledge Editing for Large Language Models
hits.note: TLDR: This paper introduces the Latent Knowledge Scalpel (LKS), an LLM editor that manipulates the latent knowledge of specific entities via a lightweight hypernetwork to enable precise and large-scale editing.

hits.title: Norm Growth and Stability Challenges in Localized Sequential Knowledge Editing
hits.note: corpus-seen; TLDR: The technical challenges with continuous and localized sequential knowledge editing are highlighted, including fine-tuning, hypernetwork-based approaches, and locate-and-edit methods, and their implications for maintaining model stability and utility are highlighted.

hits.title: TISKE: Two-Stage Incremental and Scalable Knowledge Editing for LLM-Based Intelligent Services
hits.note: TLDR: TISKE, a Two-stage Incremental and Scalable Knowledge Editing method for LLMbased intelligent services, achieves superior performance across reliability, generality, and locality metrics, validating its effectiveness and scalability for LLM-based intelligent service platforms.

hits.title: Editing Language Model-based Knowledge Graph Embeddings
hits.note: TLDR: This paper proposes a new task of editing language model-based KG embeddings, and proposes a simple yet strong baseline dubbed KGEditor, which utilizes additional parametric layers of the hypernetwork to edit/add facts.

hits.title: Reinforced Lifelong Editing for Language Models
hits.note: TLDR: This work observed that hypernetwork-based lifelong editing aligns with reinforcement learning modeling and proposed RLEdit, an RL-based editing method, which outperforms existing methods in lifelong editing with superior effectiveness and efficiency.

hits.title: Task-Adaptive FFN Editing for Continual Blind Image Quality Assessment
hits.note: TLDR: ContEditIQA is proposed, a parameter-efficient framework for continual BIQA that selectively edits a pre-trained Vision Transformer rather than retraining it, establishing selective model editing as an effective and scalable paradigm for continual BIQA.

hits.title: PropMEND: Hypernetworks for Knowledge Propagation in LLMs
hits.note: TLDR: This work meta-learns how to modify gradients of a language modeling loss to encourage injected information to propagate in knowledge propagation, extending the meta-objective of MEND so that gradient updates on knowledge are transformed to enable answering multi-hop questions involving that knowledge.

hits.title: AlphaEdit: Null-Space Constrained Knowledge Editing for Language Models
hits.note: TLDR: AlphaEdit, a novel solution that projects perturbation onto the null space of the preserved knowledge before applying it to the parameters, theoretically proves that this projection ensures the output of post-edited LLMs remains unchanged when queried about the preserved knowledge, thereby mitigating the issue of disruption.

hits.title: WikiBigEdit: Understanding the Limits of Lifelong Knowledge Editing in LLMs
hits.note: corpus-seen; TLDR: This work aims to bridge research into lifelong knowledge editing to real-world edits at a practically relevant scale, and introduces WikiBigEdit; a large-scale benchmark of real-world Wikidata edits, built to automatically extend lifelong for future-proof benchmarking.
